O₂ Odyssey · Module 2 · Unit 1 · Game 1

Baker Street

Dorothy is seventy two, has never been active, and is pink in the face after five minutes of walking. Bronwyn is four years older and barely breathing. Play twelve weeks of Dot's mornings and find out what can still change, what cannot, and why chess goes better after a walk.

Mouse or touch for everything. Scroll or drag in the first act. 1, 2, 3 pick a choice, Enter continues, M opens the inside view, P pauses, Esc closes a card. Every object in a scene can be clicked for its science card. Wrong answers never end the game.
